We need to determine number of unique carbon environments in a given compound. But we have no structure provided in the prompt. Possibly the compound is implied from previous context? Not given. We may need to retrieve carbon NMR spectra for the sample at hand, then count distinct peaks. Use carbon_nmr_spectra tool. That will give a string with peaks. Then count unique chemical shift values (distinct peaks). That corresponds to number of unique carbon environments.

Thus we should call carbon_nmr_spectra.
